title: Universal resolution normalization of the completed-coefficient Roos comparison
statement: For any adic coefficient datum d over a commutative ring A in universe u+1 and any scheme U in universe u, the literal integral Roos functor on complexes of strict N-op towers of pbcModules U (pbcAdicCompletion U d), followed by localization, is naturally isomorphic to localization followed by completedTowerRlim d U. For every quasi-isomorphism r:X to I with I K-injective and all I terms injective, the ordinary termwise limit maps to the Roos complex of I by iota whose first coordinates are precisely the limit projections and whose shifted coordinates vanish. Under rho, derived r followed by the canonical K-injective derived-limit computation and Q(iota) equals Q(Roos(r)). The coefficient module and literal Roos notation are as in [def-weil-pbc-proper-integral-ordinary-data].

proof.text: Use Grothendieckness of module sheaves and their tower category, and exactness of countable pro-etale products, to specialize the existing normalizedRoosIso to the universal derived-limit unit, transported by strictTowerLimitIso. The literal integral Roos functor and the shifted mapping-cone functor are identical.

On a K-injective tower I the limit inclusion roosι is a quasi-isomorphism. Its first coordinates are the ordinary limit projections and its shifted coordinates are zero. Transport along the canonical termwise-limit isomorphism. The normalization equation and the derived-unit computation cancel to give rho(I) followed by the derived-limit computation and Q(iota) equal to identity. Naturality of rho along any quasi-isomorphism r gives the required formula for every resolution.

theorem pbc_integral_strict_roos_resolution
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (U : Scheme.{u}) :
    ∃ ρ : HomologicalComplex.complexOfFunctorsToFunctorToComplex ⋙
        integralOperationsRoosFunctor ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ completedTowerRlim d U,
      ∀ (X I : CochainComplex (pbcTowers U (pbcAdicCompletion U d)) ℤ)
        (r : X ⟶ I) [QuasiIso r] [I.IsKInjective]
        (_hi : ∀ i : ℤ, Injective (I.X i)),
        ∃ ι : ((lim : pbcTowers U (pbcAdicCompletion U d) ⥤
              pbcModules U (pbcAdicCompletion U d)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I ⟶
            integralOperationsRoos I.asFunctor,
          (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ),
            ι.f i ≫ (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst
                (towerTransitionEndomorphism (K := fun n : ℕ ↦ I.asFunctor.obj (op n))
                  (integralOperationsTowerStep I.asFunctor))).f i ≫
              (Pi.π (fun m : ℕ ↦ I.asFunctor.obj (op m)) n).f i =
            ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (lim.π (op n)) (.up ℤ)).app I).f i) ∧
          (∀ (i j : ℤ) (hij : i + -1 = j),
            ι.f i ≫ (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.snd
                (towerTransitionEndomorphism (K := fun n : ℕ ↦ I.asFunctor.obj (op n))
                  (integralOperationsTowerStep I.asFunctor))).v i j hij = 0) ∧
          ρ.hom.app X ≫ (completedTowerRlim d U).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map r) ≫
              (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso
                (lim : pbcTowers U (pbcAdicCompletion U d) ⥤
                  pbcModules U (pbcAdicCompletion U d)) I).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map ι =
            DerivedCategory.Q.map (integralOperationsRoosFunctor.map
              (HomologicalComplex.complexOfFunctorsToFunctorToComplex.map r))
